no_go_findings.summary: Production capture setup and finalization cannot accept or forward the opt-in target, and the compact report omits the personal-threat episode join. Real captures therefore use target=None and cannot fail closed for a requested join.
Authoritative no-threat on the same tick as safe clearance closes PersonalThreatEpisodeOpen before recording falling, so a later rising edge can remain unpaired.

required_repair: Emit falling before closing the episode when authoritative no-threat is observed on the same tick the child becomes terminal.
Add an explicit validated capture CLI target containing actor, scope, route, and parent identity.
Forward the target through the public finalization wrapper into the existing low-level demux.
Retain the complete personal_threat_episode_join object in the compact final report.
Preserve target=None compatibility for ordinary captures.
deterministic_fixtures: The same-tick safe-clearance and authoritative no-threat fixture emits falling before episode close; later authoritative threat emits rising and joins exactly one new generation.
A public finalize_capture fixture passes only with a complete requested join.
Missing, malformed, contradictory, or identity-drifted requested joins fail the evidence-demux gate.
An ordinary public finalize_capture path without a target remains compatible.
Existing continuous-presence and threat-GUID-churn negatives remain green.

acceptance: Same-tick authoritative no-threat and safe clearance emits falling before close, and later rising joins exactly one generation.
The public capture-finalization path validates and forwards the exact target and retains the full join in the compact report.
A requested incomplete, malformed, contradictory, or identity-drifted join fails closed while target=None remains compatible.
Focused tests, py_compile, diff check, and the module-form workloop status command pass before independent review.
